title: Little Girl Petting Small Goat, 1958 B&W Vintage Snapshot Photo
description: A black and white vintage snapshot dated May 1958 showing a young girl bending down to interact with a small animal, likely a kid goat, outdoors near a vertical-slatted fence. Bright sunlight casts distinct shadows on the ground. The top margin includes the original photofinisher date stamp reading 'MAY • 58'.
